liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Atlantic City** (1 review): Singled out as a killer cover [5]
- **Wanted Dead or Alive $** (1 review): Reviewer calls the cover a surprise highlight, alongside Wild Horses [5]

## Setlist highlights

- **Atlantic City**: back after 210 archived shows (988 days); mythic rare: 2 archived performances [8]
- **Going to the Races**: rare: 5 archived performances [8]
- **Train That Carried My Girl**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Walkin’ Boss**: rare: 4 archived performances [8]
- **Wanted Dead or Alive $**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [8]
- **Stone Walls & Steel Bars**: rare: 13 archived performances [8]
- **Wild Horses**: rare: 11 archived performances [8]
- **Roving Gambler**: rare: 4 archived performances [8]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2019-11-10.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 132 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **billystrings2019-11-10.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 132 min; rated 2.5/5 by 2 [2]
- **bs2019-11-10.litz.neumannKM150.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 132 min [3]
- **bs2019-11-10.litz.neumannKM150.flac16**: source not stated; 23 songs; 132 min [4]

## Around the show

- Sold-out crowd was fired up and engaged all night, and the band fed off that energy [5]

- **billystrings2019-11-10.litz.schoepsMK41v.flac16**: taped by Keith Litzenberger; transferred by Keith Litzenberger; source: Schoeps MK41v's(@ Soundboard 11.8ft high)>Schoeps KCY250/5i>Schoeps VST 62iu>Sound Devices MixPre-10 II(recorded at 32 Bit Float/48 khz) [1]
